title: Chapter 291 Wind Chasing Knight Camp
content:
Chapter 291 Wind Chasing Knight Camp

Yoshida Mundo's right eye twitched, and he felt confused, and he was about to say something.

A mighty three-headed hell dog suddenly appeared in front of him.

On the back of the three-headed dog, a god of war wearing a fiery red armor, a golden helmet, and holding a blood-red spear shocked him.

The opponent was condescending and pointed his spear at him. Yoshida Mondo almost peed in fear.

The main thing is the opponent's mount, which is 2 meters high, has three dog heads, and reveals sharp fangs, which is terrifying.

"Who are you?"

"The person who killed you."

Mondo Yoshida suddenly felt that his body could not move, and he was tightly bound by four dark chains.

Wang Shuo used a basic attack and a big move to knock out Mondo Yoshida in seconds.

Sakura Taniko saw the human head rolling down at her feet, and it was like waking up from a dream.

Taking a closer look at the face of the man on the three-headed dog, he couldn't help but feel like he was dead.

She immediately wanted to become invisible and run away.

Wang Shuo also noticed Sakura Guzi at this time and immediately used "Abyss Swamp".

After becoming invisible, you can only move your body slowly, but if you are in a swamp, you will fall down after moving.

Sakura Taniko's invisibility skill was broken instantly.

Because somewhere in the swamp, bubbles are constantly bubbling.

"Good."

Wang Shuo shouted, and Gude immediately understood and shot a "three-star cascade" at Sakura Millet.

He was shot to death on the spot.

There is no suspense in the next battle.

Wang Shuo sent people to block the exit and kept firing arrows. Even if he was invisible, his position would still be exposed if he was shot.

Invisibility does not provide immunity to physical attacks.

The Golden Fire Cavalry and the Hell Knights continued to charge and kill.

These ninja troops only have higher agility and faster movement and attack speeds, but no matter how fast they are, can they be faster than war horses?

In the time of a stick of incense, the battle is over.

"A group of local chickens and wardogs dared to sneak attack on Wana Town. They simply did not know whether to live or die."

After cleaning the battlefield, Wang Shuo led his troops back to Wana Town.

In the evening, Wang Shuo held a grand dinner.

It’s been a long time since I celebrated with my fellow citizens.

It is still very necessary to have this kind of banquet occasionally, so that the citizens can feel a sense of peace of mind in this dangerous world.

Experience the joy of living.

The next day, Wang Shuo stood by the window, lost in thought.

Just now, he received a message from Changping County Magistrate Lin Xiaodong.

"Congratulations to Mayor Wang, for relieving the crisis of the undead. Changping County is now in danger, and we hope to lend a helping hand to come to the rescue."

Wang Shuo had no ill feelings towards Lin Xiaodong. He felt that this person was gentle and elegant, much better than Lin Guanru.

Moreover, he also gave him 5 town hearts for free, which was considered a favor to him.

After checking the map, I discovered that Tamura was on his way to Changping County.

This time, Wang Shuo did not plan to go from the teleportation array to Changping County.

When you enter the county seat, you will definitely be controlled by Lin Xiaodong. Will you listen to his unified instructions at that time, or will you not?

Moreover, his main force is the cavalry force, and city defense warfare is not suitable for him.

Wang Shuo divided Li Jianguo's ballista battalion into two, leaving half to Baili Liang to defend Wana Town.

The remaining half followed him, and each of them was equipped with an ordinary war horse.

Then the Black Mountain Bandits and the Lancer Battalion were stationed in Nanshanji, with Gong Ping in charge.

Li Weiguo was also appointed as the deputy commander of the Shield Battalion to coordinate with Baili Liang to defend Wana Town.

After the arrangements were made, Wang Shuo led the three ace troops towards Tamura.

On the road.

Wang Shuo looked at Gude's horse archers.

The name "Archer" is really not worthy of being ranked alongside the other two ace troops.

So he asked: "Gude, what name do you want to give this army?"

Good thought for a while and then said slowly: "It's all up to the lord to decide."

Wang Shuo nodded helplessly.

"Why don't we just call them the 'Knights of the Storm Chasers'!"

"Thank you, Lord, for the name."
